target_customer: Health conscious consumers, founders, executives and athletes who pay for preventative lab tests, imaging, medications and physician consults
problem: Preventative testing is hard to order and interpret through the traditional system; Instalab lets consumers order tests directly and builds a personalised plan with physician guidance.
business_model: Direct to consumer testing and telemedicine with a membership; pricing pages conflict ($499 per year on one page, $42 per month on another)
product_category: Consumer preventive health testing and telemedicine

founders.name: Alex Cheung
founders.background_notes: Listed as the only founder on the YC page; background not found.

founders.name: Adora Cheung
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder by a healthcare directory profile and as CEO of Instalab and former Y Combinator partner in a 2024 podcast listing; not listed on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A consumer ordering and telemedicine layer on top of partner labs and collection services; the hard parts are compliance and operations, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: Relies on third party labs (Quest and Access Medical per a directory) and collection partners such as Getlabs; rivals can offer the same tests.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents and consumer brands entered at scale later (for example Hims and Whoop via Quest per 2025 coverage); Instalab remained active in 2026.

market_need_then: Direct to consumer testing was an established category with companies such as Everlywell and LetsGetChecked raising capital before 2022, indicating consumer demand.

identity.voice_and_tone: Proactive health, optimization and tracking with a Game Plan framing

branding.brand_signature: Personalised Game Plan of tests and actions
branding.community_and_virality: Claims users among founders, executives and athletes; Trustpilot reviews exist; 2024 Getlabs partnership press release.

brand_strength.rationale: Some social proof and a partnership release, but little independent press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Instalab is active and claims over 10,000 patients, a catalog of 600 plus lab tests and a nationwide at-home collection partnership with Getlabs announced in April 2024. No disclosed venture round was found, so growth appears bootstrapped or lightly funded, but this cannot be confirmed from public data. Its position faces competition from larger consumer testing brands.
notes: CB Insights and Extruct show about $500K (investors Y Combinator and Liquid 2 Ventures; Extruct dates it 2022-03-26 as pre-seed, CB Insights calls it a convertible note, Dealroom calls it seed); aggregator only, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Competitor search found no sources dated near the 2022 batch (results were 2025 and later coverage plus older Everlywell and LetsGetChecked items), so the list is empty. Founder education not found. Completeness pass: the 500K round dated 2022-03-26 is recorded from Extruct (pre-seed); CB Insights calls it a convertible note and Dealroom a seed. No Form D found per Healthcare Discovery, so it rests on databases.
